steps.caption: The quiet pass · fewer places to look.
One number. The Inbox counts only what an agent waits on: 3, where it said 13.
Suggested and Captured keep their numbers inside. They add nothing to the badge.
A suggestion reads as one sentence. A page's name no longer takes a line to itself.
Amber means one thing: an agent waits for you. The rest is words: “1 needs you · 1 ready”.
Home office has a report ready. No green dot: the tooltip says “1 ready”.
No blue dot on a task at work. Point at its row: “Working”.
The header says “38 words”, in one quiet line.
A click opens every count, parts of speech and their colours included.
A sidenote, with room for its margin: the sidebar stays where it is.
With the Inbox open there is no room, so the sidebar folds. The project rail stays.
⌘2 still picks a project. Its Work rows: a long question has a line of its own, no stray dot.
